findings.text: The `flow` demo's note says the fix made `framework.css`'s flow rule read `:is(p, .card, …)`. The diff actually adds `:not(.card)` to the outer flow rule, which changes the space *inside* a `.card.flow` and does nothing *between* blocks (Requirement C, content 1). Evidence: `ui/text/page.js` flow note vs the `framework.css` hunk at 1234. Rewrite the note to say what changed.

Requirement C was not met as written. The reported ~7 px h2-after-card gap did not reproduce (logged: h2 margin-top 63 px after a card). Instead, a different, unasked change landed: every `PageCard` (`part-card card flow`) sitewide now gets `--gap` between title and body instead of `--flow` (logged: 28 → 14 px). That restyles cards on every page with no shot of any page outside `ui/`. Also, the `flow` demo never puts an h2 after a `p`, so it can't show "the same space whether a card or a p is before it". Evidence: `shots/text-flow-400.png`, the only h2-after-block is the one after the card. The mastermind should either accept the card change on purpose (and shoot a page full of PageCards, e.g. /live/session/ at 400) or revert it. Either way, add an h2 after a p in `flow`.
"No page CSS (no `style()`)" is broken: the `li` demo calls `.style("--gap", "calc(var(--gap) * 0.8)")`. Evidence: `ui/text/page.js`, `items`.

`ui/readme.md` Cards line: "— the options as cards, the chosen one marked; used by every task page's Decisions tab" now sits after `alert`, so it reads as describing alert. It describes `decision`. Evidence: the diff, readme "More" section.

`ui/doc/decisions.md` still describes "four bands", "5 · 5 · 5 · 4" and "the sizes are load-bearing", and the new readme bullet about the five bands links to it for the reason. Stale: add the 2026-11-09 tree decision there. Evidence: decisions.md lines 5, 16, 28, 35.

`ui/readme.md` contradicts itself. The new Index line says four functions (`table`, `kbd`, `timeline`, `item`), but the untouched lines still say "The other seventeen have nothing to import" (line 47) and "`ui.js` (three exports…)" (line 82). Pick the true count and use it in all three places.
`ui/readme.md` Index is not "in the new order" (Requirement B): only `text` and `icon` were pushed to the top; the rest is still alphabetical. The tree order exists only in the "More" section.
Requirement A lists `h1` as a variant. It is the specimen only, with no `demo.page("h1")` child. This is defensible (the specimen is the h1), but the brief asked for it.

Requirement D: `.library-thumb` went into `ext/DesignTool/probe.js`'s IGNORE (the real skip point that LayoutCheck uses). The log reads "BROKEN 29 (27 thumbs, 2 real) → 0", but no component file changed, so the 2 "real" findings vanished without a fix and nobody said why. Tap targets under 24 px are left, logged as a `ui-kit gap`. No test case was added (logged reason: the test never reaches probe()). `ext/DesignTool`'s readme was not checked for the new IGNORE member.

Comments in the new code point at the brief: "see B below" and "see C below" in `ui/text/page.js`, and "item C of this step" in the flow note. The `framework.css` comment is 14 lines of story. A fresh reader has no B or C, so cut these to the rule and the date.

On the 1920 wall (`shots/library-wall-1920.png`), the bands draw as one continuous grid: Avatar shares a row with Row, Item and Tree, and no band label shows. So the "uneven band = wider cards" caveat added in `page.js` and the readme doesn't match what renders. The Icon tile's preview is mostly empty, with its label clipped at the bottom. That is likely pre-existing.
